instruction: I want my emails to be automatically grouped by conversation thread. Please enable message threading in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to enable threaded message view in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks that the preference 'mailnews.default_view_flags' is set to 1 (threaded view enabled) in the prefs.js file. This is similar to the original task in complexity, requiring navigation through Thunderbird's view settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify the instruction
Getter correctly retrieves Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM
Metric correctly parses prefs.js and checks mailnews.default_view_flags preference value
Expected value (mailnews.default_view_flags=1) is the correct preference for enabling threaded view
Complete instruction coverage - all requirements verified
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk
Static type warning is false positive - metric correctly handles None case with early return
